notes:
MangaView now routes the multi-select Download button and the per-chapter context-menu download through `requestDownload(_ chapters: [AidokuRunner.Chapter])`. It runs the Wi-Fi check, then `LargeDownloadConfirmation.isRequired(chapterCount:defaults: .standard)`. When that is true it stores `pendingDownloadChapters` and shows a `confirmationDialogOrAlert` titled `String(format: NSLocalizedString("DOWNLOAD_N_CHAPTERS_CONFIRM"), n)`. Cancel clears the pending chapters and queues nothing. Download queues them. Otherwise it queues at once. The gate nit area.build-only is a report line that never gates. Outside my write set: the `DOWNLOAD_N_CHAPTERS_CONFIRM` = "Download %i chapters?" string must be added to the English Localizable.strings by another task. Until it is, the title shows the raw key.
review: classified at medium by swiftgate judge diff-risk
